value.rationale: This computes an intrinsic complete Weierstrass divisor in an exceptional characteristic where the generic order sequence jumps and the total degree changes from 108 to 116. It supplies all local weights and the arithmetic splitting, a motivated exact boundary case in plane-curve osculation theory.
